caption:
Gas is at a Thanksgiving record. ⛽
AAA says regular averaged $3.82 a gallon on Sunday, vs $3.08 a year ago. The old Thanksgiving Day record was $3.58 in 2022.
And flights? Domestic round trips are up 17%, around $800 a ticket.
Are you driving, flying, or staying home this year?
first_comment: Be honest: is the holiday trip still happening, or did the price change your plans? 👇

instagram.first_comment: Trip or no trip this Thanksgiving? Tell us below. Follow @paychecktruths for daily money truths.
